memory_candidates.content: suite_selection_select (scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh) returns the bare __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel whenever ANY argument path has no mapped suite -- the sentinel DOMINATES the union rather than being merged with the other paths' real suites. A plan author who measures a multi-path phase (or several phases' paths) in one call therefore gets a false 'no suite covers this' reading and writes a dishonest Tier Justification. Always call the selector one path per call. Second coupled hazard: the DEPLOYED .claude/scripts/lib copy and the agent-system source-store copy can disagree (measured: 28 vs 26 suites for skills/skill-reviser/SKILL.md while the deployed core tree was stale), and scripts/validate-artifact.sh's Tier-Justification honesty scan uses the DEPLOYED copy -- so name the superset to over-cover rather than under-cover. Both errors were caught mechanically by validate-artifact.sh at plan-acceptance time, which is worth running before returning any plan carrying a below-full tier claim.
